content.rendered:
Portronics Iron Beats 5 Prime Party Speaker – 250W Portable Powerhouse with Karaoke Mic

Turn any gathering into a high-energy celebration with the Portronics Iron Beats 5 Prime Party Speaker. Designed for music lovers who want deep bass, loud volume, and easy portability, this wheeled party speaker delivers an impressive 250W sound output that fills large rooms, terraces, and outdoor spaces effortlessly. Whether you are hosting a birthday, house party, college event, or festive function, the Iron Beats 5 Prime ensures powerful performance with rich clarity.

Built for convenience, the speaker comes with smooth wheels and a sturdy handle, letting you move your music wherever the party goes. The included wireless karaoke UHF mic makes it perfect for live singing, announcements, or fun competitions. With bass boost technology, every beat drops harder, giving you that club-style audio experience at home.

Enjoy seamless connectivity via Bluetooth and pair your smartphone, tablet, or laptop in seconds. The long-lasting battery offers up to 6 hours of playtime, so your playlist keeps running without frequent charging breaks. Available in a bold black finish, the Portronics Iron Beats 5 Prime Party Speaker combines style, durability, and performance in one exciting package.

Key Features

  • Massive 250W sound output for loud, immersive audio
  • Wireless karaoke UHF mic included for singing and hosting
  • Advanced bass boost technology for thumping low frequencies
  • Up to 6 hours playtime on a single charge
  • Portable wheeled party speaker with easy-grip handle
  • Quick Bluetooth connectivity with wide compatibility
  • Stylish and rugged design in classic black colour

If you are searching for a powerful Bluetooth with microphone support, strong bass, and easy mobility, the Iron Beats 5 Prime is built for you. It suits DJs, party hosts, and families who want room-shaking sound without complicated setups. Simply roll it in, power it on, connect, and let the celebration begin.

Thanks to its high-performance drivers and optimized sound tuning, vocals remain clear even at high volumes. The karaoke function adds interactive entertainment, making it ideal for weddings, festive gatherings, and corporate events. With dependable build quality and energetic output, this portable stands out as a complete entertainment solution. Upgrade your music system today with the and experience booming sound, dynamic bass, and effortless portability wherever you go.
